finding.title: 101-target inventory is dead metadata for the existing core runner
finding.impact: The promised 101 Python+TS inventory is not what the existing future core runner executes; the new D136c target and the two retained 7070 targets cannot receive core-runner coverage.
finding.required_followup: Make the existing runner consume the authoritative target inventory or otherwise update its selector through the owner’s approved final-runner change, then re-review the exact source and rerun the private controls.

limits: No product tests, real test bodies, full suite, original-nine, browser, provider, render, build, ZIP, network, checkout, installation, registry mutation, or Git write was performed.
D136c security receipt and integrated home receipt are inherited evidence only; this review does not extend their scope.
Candidate remains private and final/gate tuple markers remain pending.
